description: A Fabric client-side mod designed for Hypixel SkyBlock. The mod is a bridge (using WebSocket technology) between Minecraft "Guild Chat" on Hypixel Skyblock and  a Discord channel.

releases.notes:
## What's Changed

### Changes
* Added support for Minecraft `26.2.x`
* Removed obsolete Minecraft `1.21.10` and `1.21.11` build targets
* Added compile-time GUI compatibility for Minecraft `26.1.x` and `26.2.x`
* Updated the release build to produce only the final version-specific mod JARs
* Updated supported versions and requirements in the README

### Bugfix
* Fixed image preview compatibility with the new Minecraft `26.2` chat display API
* Fixed screen, chat HUD, and GUI tick access across supported Minecraft versions

### Pull Requests
* Remove 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 and add 26.2 support by @Nharington in https://github.com/Qaiji/ApostlesBridgeNext/pull/4

### Compatibility
* Supports Minecraft `26.1.x`, tested on `26.1.2`
* Supports Minecraft `26.2.x`
* Requires Java 25 and the matching Fabric API

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Qaiji/ApostlesBridgeNext/compare/1.11.9...1.11.10

## What's Changed

### Changes
* Added a developer/debug setting for bridge connection messages
* Added optional chat output for WebSocket connect, reconnect, disconnect, success, and failure events
* Standardized bridge chat prefixes from `[AB]` to `AB >`
* Added shared Java formatter configuration for consistent formatting across editors
* Updated the README with current install links, supported versions, badges, commands, and build info

### Compatibility
* Continued support for Minecraft `1.21.10`, `1.21.11`, and `26.1.x`

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Qaiji/ApostlesBridgeNext/compare/1.11.8...1.11.9

## What's Changed

v1.11.8 fixes:

### Bugfix
* Fixed image previews not showing on hover in Minecraft `1.21.11`
* Fixed the emoji preview not rendering in the bridge settings menu
* Fixed the bridge settings menu showing the wrong mod version

v1.11.7 fixes:

### Bugfix
* Fixed the chat output bug on 1.12.x

v1.11.6 changes:

### Changes
* Added support for respecting hypixel's `/g toggle` when bridge mode is enabled
* Added reconnect/disconnect handling for the bridge websocket when guild chat is toggled
* Added message feedback when the websocket disconnects or reconnects because of Respect `/g toggle`
* Added Minecraft `26.1.x` build support
* Migrated the mod to official mappings / official named runtime compatibility
* Added compatibility handling for renamed Minecraft/Fabric APIs across supported versions
* Added a shared release output folder containing all final versioned mod jars

### Pull Requests
* feat: `/g toggle` also toggles bridge by @Nharington in https://github.com/Qaiji/ApostlesBridgeNext/pull/3

### Compatibility
* Added a `mc26.1` build for Minecraft `26.1.x`, tested on `26.1.1` and `26.1.2`
* Continued support for Minecraft `1.21.10` and `1.21.11`
